title: Cancellation of the two repeated Cech faces
statement: Under the alternating permutation law, the two face terms indexed by equal positions cancel.

source.place: Section 20.23, Tag 01FG: verification omitted immediately before Definition 01FH; signed extension preceding Lemma 01FJ

proof.text: Expand the subtype sum over the distinct pair with Finset.sum_subtype and Finset.sum_pair; order the two positions, interchanging them if necessary. For a < b, rotate the remaining indices in the interval [a,b-1] using Fin.cycleIcc. Its value formula shows that the face deleting b, followed by this rotation, is the face deleting a: outside the interval indices coincide; at its endpoint use t a = t b.

Apply the alternating cochain hypothesis to this cycle. Functoriality combines the two restriction maps. Morphisms between opens form subsingletons, so after transporting along the tuple equality the composite is the other restriction map. The SiteCechComplex supplies the chosen products and index maps.
Use Fin.sign_cycleIcc_of_le to compute the sign as (-1)^(b-a-1). The exponent equation a+(b-a-1)+1=b and the square of a power of -1 show that the two weighted terms are negatives. Their sum is zero.

mathlib_searches.query: The differential of an alternating Cech cochain is alternating and vanishes on repeated tuples
mathlib_searches.results: AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.obj and d_squared describe the differential and its square, but not permutation compatibility or repeated-tuple cancellation. No match.
Found sign_cycleRange, sign_cycleIcc_of_le and sign_decomposeFinSymm variants. These supply permutation signs, not the presheaf cochain differential statements.

mathlib_searches.query: The alternating Cech differential commutes with the sign action of permutations

mathlib_searches.results: No existing differential permutation law or repeated-tuple vanishing theorem; inspected Mathlib.GroupTheory.Perm.Fin and Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Sort, and both library roots.

lean.statement:
theorem cechDifferential_repeated_cancellation (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v}
    (U : I → X.Opens) (F : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w})
    (S : SiteCechComplex U (fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤)))
    (p : ℕ) (c : S.cochains F p) (t : Fin (p + 2) → I)
    (a b : Fin (p + 2)) (hab : a ≠ b) (htab : t a = t b)
    (hc : ∀ (s : Fin (p + 1) → I) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 1))),
      c s = (Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) • F.map (S.indexMap s σ).op (c (s ∘ σ))) :
    (∑ j : ({a, b} : Finset (Fin (p + 2))),
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : Fin (p + 2)).val •
        (F.map (S.indexMap t (j : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove).op)
          (c (t ∘ (j : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) = 0
